title: Product hero spin
line: A slow turntable arc around your product, a sweep of studio light and a launch title.

motion.prompt: A smooth product turntable shot: the camera circles a quarter turn around the product at a constant height, revealing its side as a band of studio light glides across its surface; the backdrop stays clean. Keep the main subject recognizable, sharp and true to the photo. No hands, people, text or logos enter the frame.
